name: Prochlorococcus cluster 1 (photosystem I and II)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression around mid-day (8.3 h in the paper^s time scale) with 24h periodicity, co-varying with light intensity.
functional_description: Enriched for photosystem I and II components (p=1.50E-09 and 2.50E-05 respectively). Includes genes related to photosystem I and II such as psbA, psbD, and psaA.

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 3 (cytochrome b6/f and photosystem II)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression near 12.5 hours after onset of dark with 24h periodicity.
functional_description: Enriched for cytochrome b6/f (3/7 genes, p=0.0059) and photosystem II genes (8/22 genes, p=3.70E-08).

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 4 (cytochrome b6/f)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression near 15.8 hours after onset of dark with 24h periodicity.
functional_description: Enriched for cytochrome b6/f genes (3/7 genes, p=0.073).

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 5 (respiratory terminal oxidases and protein degradation)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression near 17.5 hours after onset of dark with 24h periodicity.
functional_description: Enriched for respiratory terminal oxidases (3/3 genes, p=0.019) and degradation of proteins, peptides, and glycopeptides (5/15 genes, p=0.071).

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 6 (purine ribonucleotide biosynthesis)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression near 18.6 hours after onset of dark with 24h periodicity.
functional_description: Enriched for purine ribonucleotide biosynthesis genes (7/18 genes, p=0.0049).

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 7 (nitrogen metabolism)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression near 20.1 hours after onset of dark with 24h periodicity.
functional_description: Enriched for nitrogen metabolism genes (4/8 genes, p=0.087).

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 8 (chaperones)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression near 21.0 hours after onset of dark with 24h periodicity.
functional_description: Enriched for chaperone genes (7/14 genes, p=0.00023).

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 9 (RNA synthesis, modification, and DNA transcription)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression near 22.4 hours after onset of dark with 24h periodicity.
functional_description: Enriched for RNA synthesis, modification, and DNA transcription genes (6/23 genes, p=0.035).

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 13 (ribosomal proteins)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression near 3.4 hours after onset of dark with 24h periodicity.
functional_description: Enriched for ribosomal proteins (p=3.70E-41). Includes 45 out of 53 ribosomal protein genes.

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 16 (ATP synthase and CO2 metabolism)
temporal_pattern: Genes peak in expression near 5.5 hours after onset of dark with 24h periodicity.
functional_description: Enriched for ATP synthase (8/8 genes, p=8.40E-08) and CO2 metabolism genes (7/9 genes, p=1.80E-05).

name: Prochlorococcus cluster 18 (menaquinone and ubiquinone)
temporal_pattern: Non-expressed gene cluster per Table 1 classification.
functional_description: Enriched for menaquinone and ubiquinone genes (6/9 genes, p=0.00045).
